title: The Payment Response Never Arrived
description: A provider may have accepted a charge, but its response timed out. Your local database transaction cannot include that provider. What is the safest recovery plan?

options.text: Mark the charge failed and send a new payment ID.
options.explanation: A timeout is an unknown outcome. A new identity can create another charge if the first succeeded.

options.text: Assume the database rollback undid the provider's charge.
options.explanation: The external call did not participate in the local transaction, so rollback cannot reverse it.

options.text: Acknowledge success and discard the uncertain operation.
options.explanation: That can report a charge that never happened and leaves no durable path to resolve uncertainty.

options.text: Record the uncertain operation, reuse its provider idempotency key and reconcile status.
options.explanation: The provider's contract prevents duplicate effects within its retention window; durable state and status checks resolve outcomes the local transaction cannot determine.
